title: Orphanage, the bugle, and running errands for King Oliver
summary: He tells of being arrested for firing his father's pistol on New Year's Eve, the waif's home, learning the bugle, and growing up near King Oliver.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
